tei:div.tei:p: "$ (321)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid yongs su sdud pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston bzhugs so//

(322)༄༅// dge legs rgya mtsho'i gter chen las 'khrungs pa// don gnyis lhun grub nor bu rin po che// 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod mtha' dag yongs skong ba// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// gang gis bskal pa grangs med sngon rol nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs mchog gcig tu bskyed// mgon po de yi phrin las rgyas mdzad pa// bla med grub pa mi tra'i zhabs la 'dud// spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes bzung de nyid de// de yi rjes bzung shrī pu tra'o// de yi rjes bzung bla ma mchog gi ni// man ngag snyan nas snyan du legs brgyud pa'i// gdams pa 'di la blo bzos ma bslad cing*// ci ltar zhal nas gsungs pa'i rim pa rnams// 'gro la phan phyir brjed thor bkod pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gros bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lam gyi rim pa'i khrid ston par byed pa 'di la don bzhi ste/ thog (323)mar gdams pa'i byang tshul dang*/ gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i man ngag dang*/ gsum pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i khrid dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang 'brel ba dang*/ bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tra dzo ki de nyid/ sngon bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi sngon rol du dge slong sprul pa 'od du sku 'khrungs nas rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang phyug la chos bshad pa'i bla ma yang yin cing*/ bod yul du thon mi sa 'bo rar sku 'khrungs nas rgya gar du byon cing lotstsa bsgyur/ bod du thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ slar yang rgya gar gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ sku skye ba bzung zhing spyan ras gzigs grub pa'i tshul mdzad nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob ste/ sems can gyi don la rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung du ma dang*/ bshad sgrub smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don 'bad (324)med lhun grub mdzad pa'o// de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid dur khrod so sa gling du byon nas thugs dam lha lnga bsgrubs pas/

de rnams grub nas mngon sum du zhal bstan cing*/ so so'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyi rim pa rnams gsungs pa'o// de'i tshul yang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs sku'i khrid shes rab 'phel byed ye shes rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ spyan ras gzigs gsung gi khrid byang chub lam gyi rim pa thams cad yongs su sdud pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer rgyas pa/ tshe dpag med yon tan kyi khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i sku sgrub pa'i thabs/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba'i khrid/ dzam bha la ser po'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba ste/ khrid drug po 'di dag lha so so'i zhal nas rang rang gi sgo nas khrid kyi rim pa gsungs pa'o// de yang*/ lha de dag gi zhal nas khrid 'di dag nyams su long la gzhan la gcig brgyud du ston cig dang*/ brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du bdag cag rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa yin no gsungs/ khyad par khrid 'di dag nyams su len pa'i gang zag de mi rabs bdun gyi bar du spyan ras gzigs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa sha stag yin no gsungs nas lung bstan pa'o// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tras rjes su bzung ba ni/ paṇḍi ta shrī pu tra/ de nyid kyi rjes bzung ba ni rtogs ldan ghirti ratna/ de'i bar la gcig brgyud du 'dug cing*/ man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin pa la/ bdag gis brjed kyi dogs nas yi ger bkod pa'o// de ni brgyud tshul lo// gnyis (325)pa sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba sgom pa dang gcig /'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa dang gnyis/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor pa'i nyes dmigs sgom pa'i dmigs rim rnams khrid gzhan dang mtshungs so// gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la la bzhi ste/

ci byas thams cad thar pa'i lam du 'gro bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib thams cad myur du dag par byed pa hrīḥ yig bzhi sbyor man ngag /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'o// dang po mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ gyad dang seng ges btegs pa/ sna tshogs padma 'bum ldan gyi steng na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa bka' brgyud bla mas bskor ba/ mdun na yi dam thugs rje chen po la yi dam rgya mtshos bskor ba/ g.yas su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskor ba/ rgyab tu yum chen mo la po ti dang glegs bam dam chos rgya mtshos bskor ba/ g.yon tu byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang nyan thos mchog brgyad la/ theg chen theg dman gyi dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskor ba/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros gang ba/ 'og tu phyag drug pa dang brag lha mgon po la sogs (326)chos skyong ba'i srung ma rgya mtshos bskor ba/ srung skyob kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de dag gi skyabs zhabs na bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad tshud par bsams la/ ngag tu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i yi dam rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i dam chos rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu'i chos skyong rgya mtsho la skyabs su mchi'o// skyabs 'og dam par tshud par mdzad du gsol/

zhes mang du bzlas shing mos gus bskyed do// tshad med bzhi sgom/ de nas skyabs gnas de dag 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med pa chu la chu bzhag pa ltar ma bcos pa'i ngang la 'jog pa ni/ don gyi skyabs 'gro'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang tha mal par gnas pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu hrīḥyig dkar po tshegs drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du bsams/ de la bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu babs pas/ lus kyi nang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bkrus/ ba spu'i bu ga dang*/ rtsa sgo dang*/ chu sgo rkang zhabs sen mo'i bar nas dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa nag nu nu ru bud par bsams la/ lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dkar ltem gyis gang bar bsam pa ni sdig pa dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa nad gdon dag par byed pa'i (327)sbyor ba la lnga ste/ dang po tshad pa'i nad dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba ni hrīḥyig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun gangs chu dang ga bur lta bu bsil ba'i ngad dang ldan pa'i chu rgyun babs pas/ lus grang sil sel song bar bsams/ gnyis pa grang ba'i nad dag par byed pa la bdud rtsi khro chu khol ma lta bu tsha ba'i rang bzhin babs pas/ lus me 'bar ba lta bur tsha chil chil 'bar bar bsam/ gsum pa 'dus pa'i nad dag par byed pa la/ bdud rtsi kha dog lnga dang ldan pa bde ba'i rang bzhin can babs pas/ lus bde stong du phril phril song bar bsams pa ni/ nad dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba'o// bzhi pa gdon dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba ni hrīḥyig las khro chung phyag na rdo rje dang rta mgrin gyi rnam pa can la/ sku chung la yan lag dod pa skye mched gsal ba/ 'jigs pa'i gad mo sgrogs pa/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhal nas ham̐'u ham̐'u dang ha ha phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs par byed pa/

dpag tu med par du ma byung nas/ lus kyi nang gi gdon thams cad ba spu'i sgo nas bud par bsams pa ni/ gdon dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba'o// lnga pa sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa 'od zer spro bsdu'i sbyor ba ni/ hrī las 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan pa nyi ma stong gi 'od lta bu 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang gi sdig sgrib pa thams cad dag /mun pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bur sbyangs/ lus kyi nang 'od zer gyis gang nas/ 'od zer sna lnga phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nang gdon sdig sgrib dag par bsgoms pa ni/ sgrib pa thams cad (328)sbyong bar byed pa'i sbyor ba'o// de dag gis skabs su ngag tu yang hrīḥ'adon par bya'o// mthar rang lus 'od du zhu nas hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥyig ra ta la/ ra ta khog pa la/ de gi gu la/ rim gyis nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med kyi ngang la 'jog pa ni spyod byed chen po'o// de dag gis hrīḥyig bzhi sbyor gi gdams pa song ngo*// gsum pa ni/ phyi'i maṇḍal zhing la bkod pa/ nang gi maṇḍal lus la bkod pa/ gsang ba'i maṇḍal rtsa la bkod pa dang gsum las/ dang po phyi'i maṇḍal la gnyis te/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇḍal lo// dang po rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'am/ ma 'byor na sa gzhi spos gyis chag chag gdab la/ tshom bu bkod pa ni rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng na/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs bang rim tog dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ padma zla ba'i steng na/ dbus su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi cha lugs su bzhugs pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ 'og tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad bzhugs par bsams la/

tshom bu bkod/ gu ru buddha/ dharma/ saṃ gha maṇḍal la badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥham̐'u bam̐ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ gser dang dngul la sogs pa rin po che'i maṇḍal gyi steng du/ tshom bu nye ring ran par bkod/ (329)maṇḍal gnyis med na/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs nas bzhugs par bsgoms la/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal de ka'i steng du tshom bu bkod pa ni/ oṃ badzra bhu mi ā hūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa bzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe ā ham̐'u/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gi dbus su rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po zla gam shel las grub pa ma rmos pa'i lo tog gis brgyan pa/ lho dzam bu gling sog kha rin po che bai ḍūrya las grub pa nor bus rgyan pa/ nub ba glang spyod zlum po padma rā ga las grub pa 'dod 'jo'i bas brgyan pa/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi rin po che gser las grub pa dpag bsam shing gis brgyan pa/ gling phran brgyad kyis bskor ba/ shar lho gnyis kyi nam mkhar me shel las grub pa'i nyi ma/ nub byang gnyis kyi nam mkhar chu shel las grub pa'i zla ba/ byang shar gnyis kyi nam mkhar dus me ser po/ lho nub gnyis kyi nam mkhar sgra gcan nag po/ bar mtshams rnams su 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che ste rgyal srid sna bdun/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ gser las grub pa'i nya/ rab tu mdzes pa'i padma/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i dung*/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpal be'u/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'khor lo ste bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ gzhan yang me tog (330)ma/ bdug spos ma/

snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma ste phyi'i sgeg mo bzhi/ glu ma/ gar ma/ phreng ba ma// sgeg mo ma ste nang gi sgeg mo bzhi/ mdor na lha dang mi'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa du mas kun tu gang zhing*/ bdag gi lus longs spyod bcas pa 'di dag bla ma dkon mchog mchod 'os rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bcu bzhi'am/ bdun gyi bar du 'bul lo// gnyis pa nang gi maṇḍal lus la bkod pa ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi ā hūm̐/ pags pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe ā hūm̐/ rgyu ma lcags ri'i 'khor yug /de'i dbus su sgal tshigs dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab/ mgo bo rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang*/ lag pa g.yas shar lus 'phags po/ rkang pa g.yas lho dzam bu gling*/ rkang pa g.yon nub ba lang spyod/ lag pa g.yon byang sgra mi snyan/ mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ rna ba gnyis sgra gcan dang dus me/ sna gter chen po'i bum pa/ lce 'dod 'jo'i ba/ rkang sor bcu phyi'i lha mo bcu/ lag sor bcu nang gi lha mo bcu/ lhu'i tshigs chen brgyad bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ don snod bdun rgyal srid sna bdun/ skra dang ba spu lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di dag thams cad ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// thugs rjes (331)'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa gsang ba'i maṇḍal rtsa la bkod pa ni/ gsang gnas rtsa mchog dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ yan lag gi rtsa rnams lcags ri'i 'khor yug /dbus su dbu ma ri rgyal lhun po/ snying kha shar lus 'phags po/ lte ba lho dzam bu gling*/ mgrin pa nub ba glang spyod/

spyi bo byang sgra mi snyan/ rtsa ro ma nyi ma/ rkyang ma zla ba/ dbu ma'i mar sna sgra gcan/ yar sna dus me/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo lnga/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo lnga/ rtsa 'dabs rnams bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa 'di dag rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha la 'bul lo// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs rnams// rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis blangs nas bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gu ru maṇḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye ham̐'u/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du dbul bar bya'o// de nas mchod pa'i yul gyi lha tshogs rnams rang la bstims nas/ lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// de dag gis tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid (332)song ngo*// bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la don bzhi ste/ dang po bla ma bsgom pa ni/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma 'bum ldan dang*/ nya rgyas pa'i zla ba'i steng du/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i spyi bor paṇa chen shrī pu tra/ de'i spyi bor grub thob mi tra dzo ki sku mdog dkar po g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru sgra dang bcas pa/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pa/ ras dkar po'i smad g.yogs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pa de'i spyi gtsug tu spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i steng na bzhugs pa/

dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor 'od dpag med rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par bsgom/ bla ma de dag 'ja' tshon gyi dbus na sku gzi mdangs dang bcas pa/ gsung tshangs dbyangs bcas pa/ thugs byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin can du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ham̐'u sngon po/ lte bar hoḥ ser po/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rtsa brgyud gyi bla ma yi dam/ dkon mchog /mkha' 'gro// chos skyong thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus nas bla ma rnams kyi gnas bzhir thim pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur par bsgom/ gnyis pa mchod pa (333)'bul ba ni/ dang po phyag ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs yid kyis phyag 'tshal/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ yan lag bdun pas kha bskang*/ gsum pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol pa 'debs// grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gsol ba 'debs// paṇa chen shrī pu tra la gsol ba 'debs// rtogs ldan gīrti ratna la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma kun 'dus bla ma rim po che la gsol ba 'debs// yi dam kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// dam chos kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// de nas 'dod pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dbang bzhi rgyud la bskur bar mdzad du gsol// dga' gzhi'i ye shes rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dag snang mos gus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol// bskyed rim brtan pa thob par mdzad du gsol// byams dang snying rje 'byongs par mdzad du gsol// zhi lhag zung du 'brel bar mdzad du gsol// 'od gsal ma bu 'dres par mdzad du gsol// sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol// 'chi khar chos skur 'pho bar mdzad du gsol// bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol// tshe gcig sangs rgyas (334)'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba gdab/

bzhi pa dbang bskur ba la don bzhi ste/ dang po 'od zer gyi dbang gis sbyong byed ni/ bla ma rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo'i steng du oṃ yig dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i steng du ā yig dmar po/ snying khar rdo rje'i steng du ham̐'u yig sngon po/ lte bar dus me'i steng du hoḥyig ser po/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'phros pas/ rang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba gnas bzhir phog pas/ lus ngag yid gsum bag chags kyi sgrib pa bzhi dag /lam dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom/ gnyis pa chu rgyun gyi dbang gi chu bzhis dag par byed pa ni/ gnas bzhi'i ye ge bzhi las/ chu rgyun 'o ma lta bu dang*/ padma rā ga lta bu dang*/ bai ḍūrya zhun ma lta bu dang*/ gser btso ma lta bu'i chu rgyun byung nas/ rang gi gnas bzhir thim nas sgrib pa bzhi dag /dga' bzhi skyes/ sku bzhi mngon du byas par sgom/ gsum pa rten par byed pa yig 'bru'i dbang ni/ bla ma'i gnas bzhir gdan yig 'bru dang bcas pa rbad kyis chad nas rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas sgrib bzhi dag /dga' bzhi skyes/ sku bzhi mngon du byas par bsgom/ bzhi pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang ni/ bla ma rnams rim gyis 'od du zhu nas/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsgoms nas/ rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos pa'i (335)ngang la bzhag pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// des byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid song*/ de dag gi sngon 'gro'i khrid song nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gsum/ dang po mngon byang lngas bskyed rim sgom pa sku'i khrid ni/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/

gis chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa nyi ma phyed kyi nam mkha'i dbyings dag pa ltar/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni gzhi stong pa nyid la byang chub pa'o// stong pa ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'bum ldan gyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa la sems 'dzin pa ni gdan pad zla la byang chub pa'o// de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas pa ni/ gsung yig 'bru la byang chub pa'o// de nyid las padma dkar po sdong po rgyas pa lte ba la hrīḥs mtshan pa la sems 'dzin pa ni/ thugs phyag mtshan la byang chub pa'o// de'i 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ lha'i dar gyi smad g.yogs dang*/ nor bu'i ska rags 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya (336)rtsa brgyad 'dren pa// g.yon gyi 'og mas padma dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas shing smin dkyus spyan dkyus ring ba/ dpral ba yangs pa/ mdzod spu dkar pos brgyan pa/ dbu skra phyed bcings phyed grol ba'i lhag ma dpung zur dang zar bu rked par sleb pa/ ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa/ dbu la rin po che sna lnga'i rtse phran dang*/ snyan cha dang mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub/ mu tig sna lnga'i chun po dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal par bsgoms nas/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod la/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la dbyer med du bstim/

dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa la sogs pa 'byor na bya'o// ma 'byor na ma byas kyang chog gsungs/ de ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o// gnyis pa sngags 'dren pa bzlas pa gsung gi khrid la bzhi ste/ dang po phyi mdo ltar du 'don pa ni/ tho rengs dang srod 'khor gnyis kyi dus la babs pa'i tshe/ snying kha'i hrīḥdang sku la dmigs te/ skad sgra chen pos lhang lhang 'don pa'o// gnyis pa nang sngags ltar 'don pa ni/ snying khar padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i mthar yi ge drug pa g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang*/ slar 'od phyir 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /(337)zhing khams bde ba can du byas/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog /spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags 'dren par bsam la/ khang pa'i nang du tshor tsam du 'don pa'o// snga dro phyi dro gnyis yin/ gsum pa gsang ba sgra med du bzlas pa ni/ nyin phyed nam phyed kyi dus la bab pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bar lce rtse nas 'don pa'o// bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal bar bskyed pa'i snying khar hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang ba spu'i bu ga dang bcas pa thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skus gang*/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams la phog bde ba can du byas/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas thams cad spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ mdor na gzugs su snang ba thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi skur gyur/ sgra grags pa thams cad yi ge drug par gsal btab nas yid kyis bzlas pa byed pa'o// tsha gong dang dgong kha'o// des sngags bzlas pa gsung gi khrid srong*/ gsum pa thugs 'od zer spro bsdu la brten nas byams snying rje byang chub sems bsgom pa'i khrid ni/

khams gsum sems can thams cad la pha mar gtogs pa'i 'du shes bsgom la/ rang thugs rje chen po gsal ba'i snying khar pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥdakar po tshegs drag dang bcas pa la 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam la// rlung ro sang sang ma lan gsum (338)'bud do// slar snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i pha ma sems can rnams kyi snying kha nas bde ba dang bcas te/ mdun du thams cad bkug par bsgom/ sems can de dag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus nas rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥl thim pas/ dper na me la bud shing bsnan pa ltar hrīḥmadangs stobs gzi brjid rgyas shing rang gi sems dga' yal yal lus thams cad bde phyam phyam song bar bsams la/ 'og rlung yar 'then steng rlung phyir mnan la rlung bum pa can nus tshad bzung*/ rlung phar gtong dus rang gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad la thim pas/ khong rnams la gnas skabs su lus sems bde bas gang zhing mthar thug tu tshogs gnyis rdzogs te/ de nyid thugs rje chen po dngos su gyur par sgom mo// gtong len dngos su ma nus kyi bar du sbyang*/ mthar phyi snod thugs rje chen po la thim/ nang gi thugs rje chen po rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim/ hrīḥnam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med kyi ngang la bzhag pas don gyi bskyed rim mo// snying rje'i bogs 'don zhal las shes de ni kun rdzob bskyed pa'i rim pa song nas/ gnyis pa don dam rdzogs pa'i rim pa la don bdun te/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong*/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba/ bar do bdun no// dang po zhi gnas la yang don gsum te/ mtshan ma la brten pa'i zhi gnas dang*/

rtog pa la sems gtad pa'i zhi (339)gnas dang*/ rtog med du 'jog pa'i zhi gnas dang gsum mo// dang po la gnyis/ phyi la sems bzung ba dang*/ nang la sems bzung ba'o// phyi la'ang gnyis/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po ni lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ lta stangs bcas te/ rang gi mdun du/ ka ba/ bum pa/ shing bu/ rde'u la sogs pa gang yang rung ba zhig la/ lus gnad lta stangs dang bcas nas ma yengs par sems bzung*/ de la yengs su yang mi 'jug rtog pa yang mi 'gyed/ de thog tu glod la 'jog pa'o// gzhan yang bying rgod byung na steng 'og g.yas g.yon du sems 'dzin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa rgyal pa'i sku la sems 'dzin pa ni/ mdun du bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sku gzugs bzhag pa'am med na bsgom/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug /de thog tu ma yengs tsam du glod nas 'jog pa ni/ dag pa rgyal pa'i sku la sems bzung ba'o// gnyis pa nang na sems bzung ba la yang gnyis/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po ma dag pa'i thig le la sems bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying khar pad zla'i steng du thig le dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba sran 'bru tsam la sems bzung ste/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'juug /des rnam rtog ma spangs lam du khyer pa'i man ngag go /lam gyi zhi gnas rtog pa lam du khyer zhing rtog pa de nyid la gtad nas sems bzung ba'i man ngag ni/ gnyis pa dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa ni/ (340)rang gi snying khar pad zla'i steng du spyan ras gzigs kyi sku tshon gang pa 'od dang bcas pa la sems bzung*/ de la rtog pa yang mi 'gyed/ yengs su mi 'jug go /bying rgod byung na/ dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis ka dpral ba dang lte bar bsgom nas sems bzung ngo*// de ni mtshan ma la brten pa'i zhi gnas so// gnyis pa lhag par rtog pa spros la/ dug lnga dug gsum/

nyon mongs pa gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rnam rtog /dge ba bcu'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu'i rnam rtog la sogs/ dge mi dge'i rnam rtog gang skyes pa'i ngo bo la rtog med kyi ce re bltas pas 'dzin med du zhig nas/ rig pa gsal stong ngos bzung med par gsal gsal 'char ba yin te/ de nyid rang rig rang ngo shes pa'i rang grol gyi ngang du bskyangs/ slar yang rnam rtog gang skyes pa de nyid la sems gtad nas spang blang med par rang ngo shes par byas la rnam rtog lam khyer gyi man ngag gis nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa 'bras bu zhi gnas mthar thug rtog med la sems bzung ba ni/ gnas mun khang dben par 'bol ba'i gdan la/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ mig bar snang stong pa la had de gtad nas/ yid la 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtog pa gsum dang*/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa ste/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad rbad chod la thong*/ yid la ci'ang mi bsam/ sems nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar gsal stong 'dzin med du phyam me gsal le/ hrig ge bzhag pas/ bde gsal mi (341)rtog pa'i zhi gnas skye'o// de nyid la chags pa dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ bying rgod zhugs ma zhugs brtag la/ skyon yon phye ste ngo sprad do// gnyis pa lhag mthong la don gsum ste/ dang po rgyu'i lhag mthong la sems la rnam par brtag cing dpyad nas bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar bdag gi sems 'di gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas/ gang du 'gag par 'gyur zhes/ skye 'gag gnas gsum kyi ngo bo la brtag cing dpyad/ 'byung ba lnga rang gi lus la skyes sam/ gnas sam/ 'chi'am/ snyam du brtag cing dpyad par bya'o// gzhan yang sems la kha dog dkar dmar ser ljang khra la sogs pa'i kha dog yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te med pa zhig snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang bdag gi sems 'di sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dbyings sam/

zlum po/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ nar mo/ 'jong mo la sogs pa'i dbyibs su grub pa zhig yin nam/ dbyibs med pa zhig yin snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ sems las rnam par rtog pa gzhan zhig yin nam/ 'on te rtog pa sems yin zhes brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang phyi rol gyi snang ba las sems byung ngam/ 'on te sems las phyi rol gyi snang ba byung*/ zhes brtag cing dpyad/ brtag mkhan gyi sems la sems kyis blta zhing brtag dpyad byed/ sems de nyid yod pa zhig gam 'on te med pa zhig /'on te gsal ba zhig gam/ 'on te mi gsal ba zhig /'on te bde ba zhig gam/ 'on te mi bde ba zhig /bdag yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te bdag (342)med pa zhig /rtag pa zhig gam/ 'on te mi rtag pa zhig /zhi ba zhig gam/ 'on te ma zhi ba zhig snyam du brtag /'on te snang ba zhig gam/ 'on te mi snang ba zhig snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems de ci lta bu/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems de ji lta bu snyam du legs par rang gis sems la rang gis brtag cing dpyad/ mnyam par 'jog mkhan gyi rig pa'i ngo bo la yang legs par brtag cing dpyad do// de yang sems de dag gcig gam/ tha dad du brtag cing dpyad do// de'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ ngo bo rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ de nyid rig pa 'gag med kyi rol pa cir yang 'char zhing snang ba 'di thams cad skye ba med pa gnas pa med pa/ 'gag pa med par ro snyoms pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam par 'gag pa med kyi rig pa du mar 'char zhing snang stong dbyer med pa/ blo 'das nam mkha' lta bu gsal rig stong gsum mtha' dbus med pa zhig 'dug go /zhe na/ de kho na nyid do zhes gzhi lam 'bras gsum lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ bden pa bzhi/ dga' ba bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug

/sa bcu/ lam lnga/ thabs shes gnyis/ bden pa gnyis/ skyabs 'gro/ bshags pa/ srung ba/ sems skyed/ tshogs gnyis/ snying rje/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ zhi lhag /dkon mchog gsum/ sku gsum/ ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad (343)sems rang ngo shes po'i steng nas ngo sprad pa la mkhas par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa ngo bo'i lhag mthong la tha mal gyi shes pa so mar ngo sprad nas cig car du nyams su len pa ni/ sems gnyis skye 'gag 'jig gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin las grol zhing*/ ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa 'gag med kyi rig pa yul med du mar snang zhing gsal ba/ mthong bya mthong byed kyi 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi dmigs pa'i yul las 'grol ba/ gang yang yid la mi byed pa yid byed dang bral ba/ de nyid la bzo bcos ma byas pas lhugs pa/ bya ba thams cad dang bral bas byar med gang shar ngos 'dzin dang bral bas 'dzin med/ mnyam bzhag gi shes pa la bcos bslad dang bral bas had de ba/ mtshan 'dzin med pas stong sang nge ba/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sa le ba/ rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gyis ma gos pas rjen ne ba/ rang ngo rang gis shes pas hrig ge ba/ yul yul can 'dzin pa zhig pas snang sems dbyer med zang thal du phyam me ba/ rig pa ma bcos par rang lugs su 'jog pas tha mal gyi shes pa rnam rtog lu gu rgyud du snying mi 'jug pas rig pa so ma zhes bya ste/ 'di lhag mthong nyams su blangs pa'i ngo bo dngos gzhi yin no// yang sems nyid spyan ras gzigs kyang yin te/ thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'gro ba yongs la phyogs med du gzigs pas na spyan ras gzigs so// rnam rtog mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i blo 'das kun mkhyen gyi spyan gyis chos thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu ma 'dres (344)pa rang gsal du gzigs pas spyan ras gzigs so// rang rig ye shes kyi spyan gyis chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don gzigs pas spyan ras gzigs so// gzung 'dzin dbyings su dag pa'i spyan gyis spros bral 'od gsal ba'i sems nyid gzigs pas spyan ras gzigs so/

zhes ngo sprad par bya'o// gsum pa mthar thug gi zhi lhag zung 'jug nyams su blang bar bya ni/ sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas gsal stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog pa ni zhi gnas/ de'i rang bzhin mthong zhing shes pa ni lhag mthong yin no// de yang sems nyid mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi zhi lhag zung 'jug ni sems nyid skye ba med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ de nyid 'gag pa med pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rang bzhin stong nyid du gnas pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sna tshogs du mar rig cing snang ba gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sems kyi ngo bo kha dog dang dbyibs su grub pa med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rang bzhin 'od gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral// sems kyi ngo bo stong zhing bdag med blo las 'das pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char bas snang ba'i mtha' dang bral/ des na rtag chad mtshan 'dzin gyi mtha' las 'das pas gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med pa zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs sgyu ma lta bu la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ de dag rang bzhin med pas stong pa nyid du (345)shes shing mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ sems de'i ngo bo stong nyid blo 'das su mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bskyed rim chu zla lta bu la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang snang chu zla lta bu la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ rten 'brel skye med snang stong dbyer med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// lam gyi mthar thug bde ba chen po la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ de nyid zhen med stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas/

ngo bo spros bral stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bcos slad med pa'i rig pa so ma la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ bdag med rig stong dbyer med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// mdor na chu zla dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang*/ brag ca ltar snang ba las gzhan pa'i stong nyid med/ stong pa las gzhan pa'i snang ba med/ snang stong dbyer med nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba ltar rtogs nas/ de'i ngo bor 'jog pa ni/ zhi lhag zung 'jug ces bya'o// des rdzogs rim zhi lhag zung 'jug gi khrid song nas/ gsum pa rtsal sbyong nyin par gyi sgyu lus sgom pa ni don bzhi ste/ thog mar sgyu lus kyi sngon du 'gro ba ku su lu'i tshogs gsog ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug gi nam mkhar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ (346)rin po che dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bsgom la rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po zhig tu gyur nas gsang gnas su gnas pa de/ spyi bo'i gtsug tshangs bug nas skar mda' gtong ba ltar don pas lha mo'i thugs khar thim par bsgom/ de nas rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa des/ mdun du thod pa'i sgyed po gsum sprul pa'i steng du/ rang gi mgo bo smin mtshams nas bregs pa'i ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar pa/ stong gsum gyi tshad tsam gsal ba'i nang du/ rang gi lus kyi sha khrag dum bur gtugs nas/ blug pa'i 'og nas me sbar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ sha khrag thams cad bdud rtsir dkar mer gyis zhu nas/ yang*/ oṃ āḥ ham̐'u/ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs kar hrīḥbasam/ de las 'od zer zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rtsa brgyud bla ma/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/

mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba rig drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur pa'i thugs kha nas 'od zer gyis bkug nas/ rang gi mdun du bzhugs pa'i zhal du/ bdud rtsi dkar sib sib drangs pas lus thams cad zag med kyis bde bas gang bar bsams nas rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ chos dkon mchog rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge 'dun (347)dkon mchog rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rig drug rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ thams cad tshims par bsam zhing*/ de dag thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang sgrol mar gyur nas/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra di ri ri 'don par bsgom/ 'di dag thams cad sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam du bsgom la de nyid kyang rang gi blos bkod pa ma gtogs logs su grub pa med/ bden med kyi rang la nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus spyir sbyang ba ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kun rdzob kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yin te/ bden med bsgom pa'i tshul yang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di dag /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang nas byung*/ gang du 'gro snyam du brtag cing dpyad pas na/ gang nas kyang ma byung*/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ gang du'ang gnas pa med de/ sems dag ma dag gi snang ba tsam ste/ dper na sgyu ma dang rmi lam sprul pa dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu snang ba tsam las/ rang bzhin grub pa med par shes par bya'o// 'o na 'khor ba 'di ci las byung zhe na/

bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa las byung*/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa byung ba lnga las byung ngam/ 'on te lus kyi cha las byung*/ 'o na bdag de gang las byung brtag par bya'o// de nas nga dang nga (348)yir 'dzin pa las 'khor ba byung ba mthong nas/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa 'das pa zhig yin nam/ 'on te ma 'ongs pa zhig yin nam/ 'on te da ltar byung ba zhig yin nam snyam du brtag par bya'o// de las 'das pa ni// 'das zin te bdag ma grub/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes pas dmigs pa'i yul du byar med/ da lta ba ni rig pa skad cig ma'i ngo bor yud tsam du yang grub pa med pas stong pa nyid do// des na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin grub pa med par shes par bya'o// ma grub bzhin du mar snang ba sgyu ma dang rmi lam sprul pa lta bu/ rkyen las skyes pa brag ca dang*/ chu zla me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ mi rtag cing g.yo ba nam mkha'i glog dang*/ zil pa chu bur dang sprin dang khu rlangs lta bu'o// snang la rang bzhin med pa mig g.yor dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'o// des na med bzhin du phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di dag thams cad sems kyi 'khrul snang tsam du zad de/ dper na mi 'ga' zhig gnyid pa'i rmi lam mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang*/ rmi lam de dag la rang bzhin med cing grub pa med par ltar/ chos thams cad de ltar rtogs par bya'o// chos thams cad de lta bur rtogs nas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa la 'bad par bya'o// des sgyu ma spyir sbyang ba song nas/ gsum pa bye brag tu sbyang la gsum ste/ lus snang stong du sbyang ba ni/ mdun du me long zhig bzhag la/ rang nyid de la shar du bcug la de la bstod pa smad pa byas shing*/ dga' ba dang mi dga' ba e 'dug lta/ mi dga' na rang nyid de lta bur sgyu lus (349)sbyang ngo*// gzhan yang rang gi g.yas nas gshin rje mi sdug pa'i gzugs can gyis sta re me 'bar bas gzhog par bsgoms la/

g.yon du lha mo yid du 'ong bas tsan dan gyi lde gus byugs par bsgoms nas ni/ de la dga' mi dga'i sems 'dug na sems de'i ngo bo la lta zhing*/ gshin rje dang lha mo yang rang gi sems snang tsam du shes par bya'o// sems la rang bzhin med pa snang ba sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam lta bu la chags sdang gi blo mtha' dag rang bzhin med pas mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sgyu lus sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa ngag brag ca lta bur sbyang ba ni brag ca yod pa'i sar phyin nas/ brag ca la bos pas/ ji ltar bos pa'i skad lan smra bar 'gyur te/ de la rang gis bos pas sgra skad phyi rol tu snang ba tsam las phyi rol tu grub pa med pas/ sgra thams cad brag ca lta bur ro snyoms par sbyang ngo*// gsum pa yid rmi lam sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur ma grub pa thams cad 'khrul pa'i tshe/ yod pa ltar snang mod kyi/ don la rang bzhin grub pa med de/ ngo bo la bltas na nam mkha' lta bu ste/ rnam rtog gang shar bdag med 'dzin med gsal stong blo 'das su sbyang bar bya'o// bzhi pa dag pa'i sgyu lus sbyang ba ni/ snang ba thams cad thugs rje chen por bsgom/ sgra grags pa thams cad yi ge drug pa'i sgra ku di ri ri bgrang bar bsgom/ lha 'di dag ni gang nas kyang ma byung*/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ rang gis sems snang tsam du rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam du bsgom la spros bral du bzhag go /des dag pa'i sgyu lus sbyang ba song*/ bzhi pa mtshan (350)mo'i rmi lam la don bzhi ste/ dang po rmi lam gyi sngon 'gro ni/ ku su lu'i tshogs gsog gong ltar bya'o// gnyis pa rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ spyir sbyang ba dang bye brag tu sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di dag rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ lus 'di yang rmi lam gyi lus yin/ rmi lam gyi yul dang lus la bden pa med/ ji ltar sprul zhing bsgyur yang rung snyam du bsam la sprul bsgyur byas par bsgom mo// gnyis pa bye brag tu sbyang ba ni/

rang gi mdun du sa'i 'obs chen po dang*/ ri mthon po dang*/ brag g.yang chen po'i kha nas rang nyid lhung bar bsam la/ de'i mod la/ 'di rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yul la bden pa med/ rmi lam dang sems la rang bzhin grub pa med/ brag g.yang 'di yang rmi lam gyi brag g.yang yin/ sa'i rang bzhin rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ de las su zhig 'jigs snyam du sa dang rang gi sems bsres nas sa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur par bsgom/ mchod sprin gyis mchod nas/ thams cad chos sgra sgrogs par bsgom mo// yang mdun du mtsho chen po dang*/ chu klung chen po'i nang du rang nyid lhung bar bsam/ nga gnyid pa yin// 'di rmi lam gyi lus dang chu yin/ de la bden par grub pa med/ chu'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa yin/ de las su zhig 'jigs snyam du/ rang gi sems dang chu bsres nas chu thams cad mi bskyod par bsgom/ yang mdun du me'i 'obs dang me chen po 'bar ba'i nang du/ rang nyid lhung bar bsgom nas/ nga gnyid pa yin/ 'di rmi lam gyi lus dang me yin/ (351)de la bden par grub par med/ me'i rang bzhin 'od dpag med yin/ de la su zhig 'jigs snyam du rang gi sems dang me bsres nas/ me thams cad 'od dpag med bsgom/ yang mdun du rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag ngam me ba zhig bsam nas/ de'i nang du tshud pas tshub khyil khyil byed par bsgom/ nga gnyid pa yin/ 'di rmi lam gyi lus dang rlung yin/ de la bden par grub pa med/ rlung gi rang bzhin don yod grub pa yin/ de la su zhig 'jigs snyam du rang gi sems dang rlung bsres nas/ rlung thams cad don yod grub par bsgom pa'o// yang mdun du bar snang stong pa la rang nyid lhung bar bsam/ nga gnyid pa yin/ 'di rmi lam gyi lus dang nam mkha' yin/ de la bden par grub pa med/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin rnam par snang mdzad yin/ de la su zhig 'jigs snyam du rang gi sems nam mkha' dang bsres nas/

nam mkha' rnam par snang mdzad kyis gang bar bsgom mo// de ni bye brag tu sbyang ba'o// gsum pa rmi lam bzung ba la don gsum ste/ rab mi rtog pa la 'dzin pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor thugs rje chen por tshon gang ba zhig bsam/ gsang gnas su gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo tshon gang ba zhig bsam/ de nas spyi bo'i thugs rje chen po las thig le dkar po zhig chad nas snying khar byung bas gti mug dag /gsang gnas su gsang ba ye shes las thig le dmar po chad nas snying khar sleb nas 'dod chags dag /de gnyis nye bar gyur pas zhe sdang dag /de nas thig le 'bros 'ded gyi tshul du 'khor pas bum (352)dbang*/ reg pas gsang dbang*/ reg pa las bde ba byung bas shes rab ye shes dbang*/ gcig la gcig thim nas 'od du yal bas dbang bzhi pa'o// slar yang chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dmigs pa med par thag bcad nas/ sems ma yengs par gsal stong gi ngang la gnyid log go /de ni mi rtog pa la brten nas 'dzin pa'o// 'bring 'dun pas 'dzin pa ni/ gong gi sbyang thabs de dag bcu la dmigs pas bzung*/ khyad par du phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di dag rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ rang gi lus 'di yang rmi lam gyi lus yin/ rmi lam gyi yul dang lus la bden pa med/ ci ltar bsgyur bsgyur yin snyam du 'dun pa drag po bya'o// dang po thugs kar thig le la rig pa gtad nas 'dzin pa ni/ de nas nub mo gnyid la rab rib 'gro khar 'dun pa ma yengs par rmi lam bzung la/ lus glod nas dran pa ma yengs tsam byas pas zin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa dbang po tha ma dmigs pas 'dzin pa la gsum/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom la ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang blang*/ rmi lam zin par gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gi mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ thig le dmar po 'od zer bcas pa la sems bzung la gnyid yog pas zin no// gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la brten nas 'dzin pa ni/

mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po 'od zer dang bcas pa la dmigs pa gtad na zin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rmi lam sku la brten nas 'dzin pa ni/ mgrin par padma dmar (353)po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar thugs rje chen po tshon gang pa 'od zer dang bcas pa la dmigs pa gtad nas 'dzin pa yin no// de dag ni rmi lam 'dzin pa'i rim pa song ngo*// 'di yang gegs sel 'byam gcod dang ldan pa dgos shes gsungs/ bzhi pa sprul zhing bsgyur nas spel ba ni/ rmi lam zin nas sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la sogs 'byung ba lngar sprul pa dang*/ brgya byin dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang*/ cang shes rta dang*/ glang po che dang*/ khyung dang*/ sems can gyi rigs du mar sprul par bya'o// de nas bsgyur ba ni/ sa chur bsgyur ba/ chu mer bsgyur ba/ me rlung du bsgyur ba/ rlung nam mkhar bsgyur ba/ nam mkha' rigs drug gi sems can du bsgyur ba/ rigs drug gi sems can bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi lhar bsgyur bar bya'o// res 'ga' snang bar bsgyur ba dang*/ res 'ga' mi snang bar bsgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ rags pa phra bar sprul zhing bsgyur ba dang*/ phra ba rags par sprul zhing bsgyur ba dang*/ mang po gcig tu sprul zhing bsgyur ba dang*/ gcig mang por sprul zhing bsgyur ba la sogs pa shes par bya'o// des sprul zhing bsgyur ba song*/ de nas spel ba ni/ sems can du mar sprul zhing bsgyur nas gcig nas bcu/ bcu nas brgya/ brgya nas stong*/ stong nas khri// 'bum/ bye ba/ sa ya/ de nas dung phyur la sogs kyi bar du spel bar bya'o// de bzhin lha bya spyod dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med du ma dang*/ khyad par spyan ras gzigs sku rkyang dang*/ bla med la sogs (354)par sprul zhing bsgyur ba dang*/ gcig nas dung phyur gyi bar du spel bar byas nas ma ṇi la sogs sngags 'dren par bya'o// lnga pa yul snang gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/

zhing sbyang ba dang*/ bgegs 'dul ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbang po rab 'od gsal rtogs pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas yul snang gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro// dbang po 'bring yid la bsam pa tsam gyis yul snang gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro// dbang po tha ma bya rgod la sogs par sprul nas phyin pas yul snang gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro// de yang thog mar rang gi khang pa dang*/ nyal sa la yul gsal bar gtan la phebs par gyur nas/ gzhan phyi rol yang phebs par 'gyur ro gsungs so// gnyis pa zhing sbyong ba ni khyung la sogs par sprul nas/ bde ba can dang*/ mngon dga' dang*/ bai ḍūr snang ba dang*/ dga' ldan la sogs par 'gro zhing zhing khams de dag la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa du mar sprul nas mchod pa dang*/ chos zhu ba dang*/ de bzhin du rang gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar sprul zhing mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas mchod pa dang chos nyan par bya'o// des zhing sbyong ba song nas/ gsum pa bgegs 'dul ba ni/ gdon rgyal po lta bu la rta mgrin lta bur sprul nas 'dul/ klu la khyung du sprul nas 'dul/ ma mo la phyag rdor dang*/ lha 'dre spyi la 'jigs byed du sprul nas 'dul/ gdon chur sprul na rang nyi ma stong du sprul nas skems pa dang*/ gdon me ru sprul pa la/ rang chur sprul nas (355)gsod pa dang*/ gdon bya rgod la sogs pa la rang khyung du sprul nas 'dul/ gdon khra ru sprul pa la rang glag tu sprul nas 'dul ba/ de bzhin du khyi la stag dang*/ bye'u la khra dang*/ ri dwags la gcan gzan dang*/ gcan gzan la seng ge dang*/ seng ge la me spung la sogs pa gang gi gnyen por gang yin pa der sprul nas 'dul zhing srog sngags 'bul du 'jug /mthar byams snying rje byang chub sems bsgom zhing*/ stong nyid kyi ngang la 'jog pa'o// de ni gdon 'dul ba'o// gsum pa 'od gsal gyi rim pa la gsum te/

dang po gzhi'i 'od gsal chos nyid gnas lugs la ngos bzung ba ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ skye gnas 'jig gsum dang bral ba/ spros bral mtha' bral de nyid/ sems can rnams kyis rtogs rung ma rtogs rung*/ 'gro ba rnams gdod nas kun khyab kyi ngo bo gnas pa yin te/ de nyid kyi don ma rtogs shing*/ bdag med la bdag tu bzung bas/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri mas sems nyid 'od gsal bsgribs nas// 'khor bar 'khyams kyang gzhi'i 'od gsal zhes bya ste/ dper na nam mkha' la sprin lta bu dang*/ bar snang la khu rlangs lta bu'o// chu dang sa lta bu'o// mar me dang bum pa lta bu'o// dbul po'i khyim du gter chen ltar sgrib pa las grol rung ma grol rung rang sems rang bzhin 'od gsal bar bzhugs so// gnyis pa lam gyi 'od gsal rtsal sbyang ba la gnyis te/ dang po nyin par rtsa thig rlung (356)gsum gnad du bsnun pa la brten nas/ 'od gsal mngon du byed pa la gsum ste/ dang po ni/ mun khang khra seng med par 'bol ba'i gdan la/ bsam gtan stegs bu bcas la/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur brla'i steng du 'jog /dpung mgo rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang*/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug /bying na lta stangs spyi bo'i gtsug na sna rtse/ snyoms na smin mtshams kyi nam mkha' la/ mig g.yo 'gul med par lta/ gnyis pa ngag rlung bcing pa ni/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// des thig le rang 'ching du gyur nas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam kun mchog ldan/ 'od gsal rtags bcu dang*/ ma nges pa'i rtags du ma 'char bar 'gyur te sems kyi rang 'od rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ dbyings rig dbyer med chos sku ru ngo sprod par bya'o// gnyis pa mtshan mo'i 'od gsal ni/ rab sems nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la gnyid pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro// des ma zin na dmigs pa la brten nas 'dzin pa ni/

rang thugs rje chen po phyi gsal nang gsal du bsgom pa'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po tshegs drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer nyi ma 'bum las lhag par 'phros pas/ lus kyi phyi nang dang gling bzhi stong gsum thams cad phyi gsal nang gsal du gyur pa la dmigs pa bzung nas gnyid log pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa 'bras bu'i 'od gsal mngon du byed pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gnyis las (357)grol ba/ rang gis rang rig cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ shes bya'i yul chos nyid rnam kun mchog ldan dang*/ shes pa'i ngo bo rang rig ye shes gnyis dang dbyer med pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ yod med bden rdzun rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba 'di nyid chos kyi sku'o// zhes ngo sprad par bya'o// drug pa 'pho ba la gsum ste/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ rang lus spyan ras gzigs mngon rtogs ltar du stong sang nge ba sgom pa'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ mar sna gsang gnas su gtad nas bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yar sna spyi gtsug tu zug pa rgya mthong kha bye ba lta bu stong sang nge ba yod par bsgom/ bu ga dgu po hrīḥdamar po re res bkag par bsgom/ de nas 'pho yul ni spyi gtsug steng gi nam mkha' 'dom gang tsam gyi cha la/ rin po che'i khri padma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du thugs rje chen po sku rnam pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs su bsgom par bya'o// de nas 'pho ba sbyang ba la don gsum/ dang po thugs kyi sgo nas 'pho ba ni/ rang gi snying khar padma zla ba'i steng du rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ snum la 'dril ba/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phro bar bsgom la/ de nas spyi bo'i thugs rje chen pos yi ge drug ma bton nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod bdag gi thugs khar 'phos shig

/ces gsungs pa'i mod la/ thig le de las thig le gcig dkar tser gyis chad nas/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud de/ thugs rje (358)chen po'i thugs kar cung zad reg nas slar yang mar babs snying kha'i gzhi'i thig le la thim par bsgom/ de lta bu brgya dang nyi shu la sogs pa rtags ma byung gi bar du sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru'i sgo nas 'pho ba ni/ rang thugs rje chen po gsal gdab pa dang*/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsal 'debs/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa'i rim pa rnams gong dang mtshungs/ bye brag tu snying khar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdamar po 'od dang bcas pa bsgom zhing*/ hrīḥlas hrīḥchad de/ bla ma'i thugs kar cung zad re gnas par bsam zhing*/ slar gzhi'i hrīḥl thim par bsgom pa ni/ sbyong ba gong dang mtshungs/ gsum pa sku'i sgo nas 'pho ba ni/ lha dang rtsa dbu ma bla ma gsal 'debs pa gong dang mtshungs/ bye brag tu snying khar zla ba'i steng du/ thugs rje chen po gsal la dod pa 'od zer dang bcas pa tshon gang ba zhig bsam la/ gcig las gcig chad spyi bor bla ma'i thugs khar reg nas cung zad gnas shing bzhugs/ slar gzhi'i lha la thim par bsam pa ni sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa las la sbyor ba ni/ 'chi ba'i rtags tshang nas/ zhen chags 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad la/ byams snying rje dang mos gus la gnas pas/ rang lus lhar gsal 'debs/ dbus su rtsa dbu ma bsgom/ spyi bor bla ma gsal gdab/ snying khar pad zla'i steng du thig le hrīḥyi ge sku gsum rim gyis bsgom nas de dag gdan dang bcas pa chad pas/ skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar bla ma'i thugs kar thim par bsam zhing*/ nam 'pho ma nus kyi bar du bsgom par bya'o// mthar bla ma (359)yang bde ba can du 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de ni las la sbyar ba'o// bdun pa bar do la don bzhi ste/ dang po bar do sbyang ba ni/ bla ma la bar do 'byong ba'i gsol ba gdab/

de nas phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di rnams thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin/ nga'i lus 'di yang bar do'i lus yin/ gzugs thams cad bar do'i gzugs/ sgra thams cad bar do'i sgra/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya thams cad bar do'o// bde sdug thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin/ de sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin/ bar do'i lus la rang bzhin med snyam du bsgom la/ chos thams cad la blang dor med par mnyam pa nyid du nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la sems rang gsal spros bral du mnyam par 'jog pa bar do chos skur sbyang ba'o// gzugs snang thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ sgra thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi sgra/ dran rtog thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi bskyed rim du bsgom nas/ de rnams nyams su blang ba ni longs sku bar do sbyang ba'o// phyi rol gyi yul snang thams cad bde ba can dang*/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ sgra thams cad dam pa'i chos kyi sgra/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rol par bsgom la/ sprul pa'i sku'i zhing sbyang pa'o// gnyis pa thim sdud brtag pa ni/ phyi rtags la/ sa chu la thim pas/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs 'chor/ dri ma mi thub/ snang ba ljid thibs 'byung ba snyam byed/ nang rtags la rlangs pa'am/ kha rlangs lta bu 'byung*/ chu me la (360)thim pa'i rtags su kha sna skam/ mchu brdzes/ nang rtags rdul dang smig rgyu lta bu 'byung*/ me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su/ phyi rtags drod mtha' nas sdud/ dbugs nang du sdud mi shes/ nang rtags su mar me btegs pa'am/ srin bu me khyer lta bu 'byung*/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su lce'i thog tu nag thig dang glal ba'o// nang rtags su nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu'am/ kha ba babs pa lta bu 'byung*/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i rtags su phyi rtags nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu 'byung*/ nang rtags su nam langs pa'i steng du nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'byung*/

de ni thim sdud brtag pa'o// gsum pa bar do sku gsum du nyams su len tshul ni/ bar do dang po chos nyid kyi bar dor chos sku'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag ni/ de nas 'byung ba lnga thim pas rlung dbu mar thim tshar nas/ ma las thob pa'i rakta gyen du 'dril bas dmar lam 'byung ste/ pha las thob pa'i thig le thur du lhung bas dkar lam pa 'byung*/ de nas khams dkar dmar nor rgyal gyi rlung rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa snying kha'i rtsa bha santa'i nang du 'dus pa las bde gsal mi rtog nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal/ rnam kun mchog ldan 'chang bar 'gyur/ de'i tshe gzugs su snang ba thams cad 'od gsal sems nyid chos sku'i rang gzugs/ sgra grags pa thams cad sems nyid chos sku'i rang sgra/ dri ro reg bya rnam shes dang bcas pa thams cad chos nyid kyi rol par sems rang bzhin 'od (361)gsal la rang ngo rang gis shes nas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas bar do 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa srid pa bar dor 'phos nas longs skur nyams su len pa ni/ bar do'i rtags thams cad man ngag dang ldan pas/ snang ba thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing du bsam/ bdag dang sems can thams cad spyan ras gzigs yab yum du gsal gdab/ sgra thams cad yi ge drug pa/ dran rtog thams cad bskyaid rim la ma yengs par byas pas/ longs spyod rdzogs par grol bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa bar do tha ma sprul skur nyams su len pa ni/ phyi rol gyi yul snang thams cad bde ba can dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur sprul/ sgra grags pa thams cad chos kyi sgrar sprul/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rol bar sprul nas/ sems can la chos ston pa la sogs bya/ gzhan yang sprul pa sgyur la brten nas bde ba can dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ mngon dga' la sogs pa'i zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis phyin nas chos nyan pa dang*/

mchod pa du ma sprul nas mchod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ des ni bar do tha ma sprul sku'i zhing du sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// de dag gis bar do'i gdams pa song nas/ bzhi pa mngal sgo dgags pa ni/ bar do gsum du grol ma nus na/ tha ma mngal sgo dgags pa ni/ pho mo sbyor ba byed pa dang*/ gnas khang la sogs par gnas pa'i snang ba byung na/ pho thams cad spyan ras gzigs su bsgom/ mo thams (362)cad rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ sgra thams cad yi ge drug par bsgom/ dran rtog thams cad chags 'dzin dang bral ba'i ngang nas bskyed rdzogs bsgom pas/ mngal sgo kheg cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro// lnga pa rjes kyi bka' rgya la bzhi ste/ khrid 'di gcig brgyud du ston pa dang gcig /tshogs 'khor bzang po gser gyi me tog dang gnyis/ khrid lung byed du med pa dang gsum/ 'di zhus nas sgrub pa byed pa dang bzhi yin ces mi tras bka' rgya btab pa'o// tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub pa'i tshul 'di ni// spyan ras gzigs kyis grub chen mi tra la// rgya gar paṇa chen shrī pu tras zhus// man ngag snyan brgyud gīrti ratna la// ji ltar gdams ngag gnad rnams ma 'phyug pa// bum pa gang byo bdag la gnang ba ni// tshig don ma 'phyug yi ger bkod pa yin// dge bas bdag gis spyan ras gzigs mgon gyi// go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lam gyi rim pa yongs su sdud pa'i khrid bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ces bya ba/ rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rje zhes bya bas yi ger bkod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po des/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la myur du 'god par gyur cig /ces bsngo ba'i rim pa dang bcas pa rdzogs so// dge bas 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob par shog// /dge'o//
